build.reproducibility: Not bit-reproducible: the inherited bundle embeds a build timestamp in a diagnostic string, so app.bundle.js, the asset build id and the worker cache id change on every rebuild of identical source. Integrity is therefore verified against the staged inventory, not against a previous build's id.
